verdict.rationale: Bruno's own programmatic surfaces are the Bruno CLI, which runs collections, overrides environment variables and generates reports, and its plain-text collection files, which it positions as working with agents. These cover only running and authoring collections, not the full range of UI features, and the probe found no public API or OpenAPI spec. missing for 10: a documented programmatic API, evidence of UI-to-API parity (environments, auth configuration, Git operations, AI features, docs publishing), an OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: With Bruno CLI, you can run your API collections with ease using simple command line commands.
add --global-env-var to override global environment variables at runtime
Collections stored as code. Works with Git, your IDE, and your agents.
